description: Home Credit default risk: DuckDB SQL features, LightGBM, isotonic calibration, SHAP, cost-based threshold, MLflow.

release.title: v1.0.0: feature pipeline, models, calibration, SHAP and cost threshold
release.notes:
First release.

- DuckDB SQL feature store: one file per Home Credit table, aggregated to one row per `SK_ID_CURR`, written to Parquet.
- Logistic Regression baseline and LightGBM with early stopping, plus a cumulative per-table ablation.
- Isotonic calibration on a held-out 10% split, with Brier score, ECE and a reliability diagram.
- SHAP beeswarm and per-applicant waterfalls.
- Cost-matrix threshold with an LGD sensitivity table.
- Every run is tracked in a local MLflow store. Optional FastAPI `POST /score`.
- 31 pytest tests (leakage, data contracts, determinism, cost maths, end to end, API) on generated fixture data. GitHub Actions runs ruff and pytest.

**Known gap:** this release has not been run on the real Kaggle data yet, so it reports no model-quality numbers. Run `bash scripts/download.sh` and `python -m credit all --check-determinism` to produce them.
